title: The Insidious Dr. Fu Manchu
description: A mystery game based on the classic novel 'The Insidious Dr. Fu Manchu' by Sax Rohmer, where players uncover the sinister plots of the enigmatic Dr. Fu Manchu and his network of agents.
intro_narrative: The game begins with the sudden and mysterious death of Sir Moses Shen, a prominent figure in the British Empire. As Dr. Chinaman, you are drawn into the investigation by your old friend Kwee Barber, who reveals the presence of a dangerous and cunning adversary, Dr. Fu Manchu, operating in London. Together, you must unravel the secrets behind Sir Moses's death and thwart the plans of this insidious villain.

required_evidence: Ebony case with instruments for curing Weymouth's madness
required_motive: To pave the way for a Yellow Empire by eliminating key figures in the British Empire and Western world.

phases.name: Initial Investigation
phases.objective: Uncover the circumstances surrounding the death of Sir Moses Shen and identify the mysterious Dr. Fu Manchu.

phases.name: Expanding the Search
phases.objective: Explore new locations and gather clues about Dr. Fu Manchu's operations and his network of agents.

phases.name: Deepening Conspiracy
phases.objective: Delve deeper into the conspiracy and uncover the true extent of Dr. Fu Manchu's plans.

phases.name: Final Confrontation
phases.objective: Confront Dr. Fu Manchu and his agents, gather final evidence, and bring the villain to justice.
